Mr. Kenneth Plumb, Secretary Federal Power Commission January 5, 1976 Page Three
W. H. Owen being duly sworn states that he is Vice-President of Duke Power Company; that he is authorized on the part of said company to sign and file with the Federal Power Commission this Amendment 1 with revised drawings bearing the date January 5, 1976 pertaining to its Application; and that all statements and matters set forth therein are true and correct to the best of his knowledge.
s/W. H. Oven
W. H. Oven
Vice President, Design Engineering
ATTEST:
s/George W. Ferguson George W. Ferguson Secretary
Subscribed and sworn to before me this 29th day of December, 1975.
s/Elizabeth A. Trammell Notary Public
My commission expires: November 21, 1979
